premises.baseline_scope: Only the baseline_booking_ids named by a scenario exist in that scenario; the catalog is not a shared seeded environment.
premises.time_axis: Hypothetical monotonic relative minutes. An interval array is [start_minute, end_minute], not a timestamp or an endpoint-inclusion rule. No business time zone, calendar validity, operating hours, DST or input precision is established.
premises.contract_scenario_conditions: For contract_backed scenarios only, requested intervals are assumed permitted and items otherwise available; only named reservation conflicts vary. These are conditional design premises, not approved date or condition policies.
premises.membership: Each persona supplies a selected hypothetical verification outcome for this scenario. This is not a live service check, policy enum, membership source, freshness rule or configured account.
premises.identity_and_access: Personas express member capabilities and booking ownership relationships, not installed roles, authentication or permissions identifiers.
premises.privacy_probes: Invented display names and example.invalid contact markers are comparison probes, never login identifiers or required product fields.
premises.concurrency: Concurrent submission is a semantic premise, not simulated or observed scheduling. No guaranteed winner, tie-break, retry policy, latency bound or liveness guarantee is asserted by the conflict oracle.
premises.execution_gate: Cannot seed or execute against an application without separately authorized adapters, authentication, known interfaces, environment and applicable policy decisions. No cleanup or seed commands are provided.

assertions: The request immediately becomes a confirmed booking and reservation of the selected physical item for exactly the requested interval.
No staff approval, separate pending stage or release-one training prerequisite is introduced; no loan is created by booking.
The requesting member sees portal confirmation with their selected item and requested interval. Immediate does not mean an invented response-time SLA.
No confirmed booking or reservation is created for the inactive member's request.
The portal explains that active membership is required; exact wording is unspecified.
No confirmed booking or reservation is created for the unverifiable member's request.
The portal explains that eligibility could not be verified; it neither claims confirmation nor treats the outcome as proof of inactive membership. No pending booking or automatic retry is prescribed.
The new request creates no confirmed booking or reservation and the portal explains that the requested interval is unavailable.
All supplied baseline reservations remain unchanged, including item, owner and interval; a failed request does not displace a booking.
The owner can view their existing confirmation, including its selected item and requested interval; a full history or list interface is not required.
The non-owner cannot view the target member's booking details. Merely showing the booking under the correct owner's name would not satisfy this boundary.
No access route, denial copy, status code or configured role is prescribed.

Availability information presented to the viewer contains neither the other borrower's display-name probe nor contact probe, and does not substitute another representation disclosing their name or contact details.
This checks member-visible information, not only whether a name is hidden in one UI element; no availability layout or API is assumed.

The failed booking outcome presented to the requester contains neither the blocking borrower's display-name probe nor contact probe, and discloses neither name nor contact details through other member-visible outcome information.
Any resulting confirmed subset satisfies no overlap and at least 30 minutes between bookings of the same physical item, including any supplied baseline.
The scenario's maximum_confirmed is a safety upper bound, not a promised count or winning actor. Any subset respecting the invariant is allowed by this safety oracle; it does not establish liveness.
A request that cannot be confirmed because of the competing reservation receives AC-04's unavailable explanation, creates no booking/reservation, and leaves existing reservations unchanged.
No winner order, tie-break, retry, lock, API response, scheduler or timing mechanism is prescribed.
